column1: For Advance Retail Inventories, all current month estimates are advance estimates and will be superseded in following months by revised estimates.

Inventories estimates released as part of the Monthly Retail Trade Report are not included in the time series. For the latest preliminary estimates, select "Monthly Retail Trade and Food Services" in the dropdown above or visit the (https://www.census.gov/retail/index.html) website.

For information on the reliability and use of the data, including important notes on estimation and sampling variance, seasonal adjustment, measures of sampling variability, and other information pertinent to this economic indicator, go to the (https://www.census.gov/econ/indicators/advance_report.pdf) [PDF], or refer to the (https://www.census.gov/econ/indicators/index.html) website, which provides a link to more (https://www.census.gov/econ/indicators/historical_data.html) for these reports.
Estimated measures of sampling variability for totals are expressed as coefficients of variation (CV). Standard errors (SE) are provided for month-to-month change and ratio estimates.
Estimated measures of sampling variability are based on data not adjusted for seasonal variation, and should be used when drawing inferences about both adjusted and not adjusted estimates.
